column1: //step Subgraphs | | Subgraphs group parts of a model into boxes. This page is built from subgraphs so each box shows the feature it describes.

//step Making a subgraph | Making a subgraph | A subgraph starts with a "double slash" //subgraph line and ends with a "double slash" //end line. Everything first used between the two lines is drawn inside the box. Take care with comments that begin with the words subgraph or end.
//step Titles | Titles | The title follows "double slash" //subgraph. Starting the title with a "double slash" // hides it and leaving it out gives a box with no title.
//step Nesting | Nesting | A box can sit inside another. Start it before the outer box ends and close each box with its own "double slash" //end line.
//step Styling | Styling | Adding a format name after the "double slash" //end line styles the box. Any of the standard formats can be used.
//step Choosing a direction | Choosing a direction | A box can have its own direction. Mermaid only uses it when no node inside the box links to anything outside it.
//step Linking subgraphs | Subgraphs ; Linking subgraphs | A subgraph title can be used in a triple like any other node. Every box on this page is linked to the central Subgraphs node in this way.

//sub The rules | Linking subgraphs | Linking needs the first line to start with "double slash" //flowchart. Give each box a title that no node uses. Mention a box title only outside other boxes or it will be drawn inside them.
//step Repeating a label | Repeating a label | The same text normally means the same node. Adding #-1 or #-2 to the end makes separate nodes that show the same text.
